title: chrysobalanus icaco subsp. pellocarpus
intro: Chrysobalanus icaco subsp. pellocarpus, commonly known as the West Indian june plum or West Indian plum, is a plant species of the family Chrysobalanaceae. It is rich in nutrients and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include the potential to alleviate various health issues such as fever, cough, and respiratory problems. The plant is also known for its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including antipyretic, expectorant, and anti-inflammatory effects. The bioactive constituents of C. icaco subsp. pellocarpus include flavonoids, phenolic compounds, and terpenoids, which contribute to its health benefits and medicinal uses.
